methodological_limitations.nature_of_event_grouping: The 20.0-second gap threshold is an empirical operational heuristic based on typical barrier cycle cadence. It does NOT represent verified physical vehicle re-identification or ground-truth vehicle identity. Vehicles queuing closely (<20s) may be clustered into a single event, while vehicles lingering in front of the gate (>20s) could be separated into two events. However, for preventing train/test data leakage of adjacent near-identical frames, this heuristic is strictly conservative.
methodological_limitations.night_sample_scarcity: The test split contains exactly 2 deep-night IR frames (out of 10 total across the dataset). While this preserves the 60/20/20 proportion, n=2 is statistically inadequate for robust generalized performance claims. Deep-night test metrics must be reported with explicit disclosure of sample size.
